historical_record.description: One of the houses in the district that predate the stucco “Sunset” row house which filled the Parkside from the 1920s — mostly larger Craftsman-style buildings put up by the Parkside Realty Company before 1925.
Built by the Hugh Keenan Construction Company, which worked mainly in the Parkside and took on street construction and block grading for the Parkside Realty Company, of which Keenan was a director.
